newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 22.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Turkey says Iraq is mobilising troops to confront Turkish incursion.
- United Arab Emirates' chief of staff says foreign forces will not remain in the Gulf.
- Lebanese president says investment in Lebanon is profitable and guaranteed.
- Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank is set up with a capital of one billion dirhams.
- Egypt and Palestinians are worried over Israeli settlement policy and its threat to the Middle East peace.
- Palestinian imports of Israeli agricultural and industrial products increase to $2.4 billion annually.
- Saudi sugar refinery to start commercial production in mid June.
